answer: A hardware attestation chain ties each identity to one TPM chip, one thread of silicon proof. First, the agent posts a 200-POA bond locked 30 days and registers the chip's key. Second, each epoch the chip signs a fresh nonce within 60 seconds. Third, three passes in a row earn a jade badge and skip the next audit; one failure burns the bond and bars the chip 90 days. An ocean of fakes shrinks to a list: 10,000 identities need 10,000 chips at $15 each, $150,000, plus 2,000,000 POA in bonds. Like a guard who trusts only the passport he can hold, the chain trusts only the chip it can ping.
